title: When the Church Wanted Their Land: Mary & Lydia vs. Religious Hypocrisy
excerpt: They stored the church's drums, dishes, and instruments. They fed the church builders for YEARS. They were baptized Catholic, born into the faith through colonization. But when Mary & Lydia needed accessible seating? 'The priest is busy.' When congregants wanted their prime land? 'You're not worthy.' This is the story of how a church separated by a mere dirt road became the enemy next door.
author: AbleHearts Team
content:

[🚀 Donate Now: Build Mary & Lydia's Accessible Home](#-donate-now-build-mary--lydias-accessible-home) --- ## The Irony of the Church Next Door **Imagine this:** You can HEAR the Sunday sermons from your living room. The church is literally **separated from your home by a dirt road**—so close you could throw a stone and hit the wall. For decades, YOUR home was the church's: - 🥁 **Storage facility** (drums, tithe dishes, instruments kept safely in your house) - 🍳 **Catering kitchen** (fed church builders for YEARS with your mother's traditional cooking pots) - 💧 **Resource center** (water, firewood, labor—all from Mary's household) **You were BORN into this faith.** Baptized Catholic as a baby. Your mother was **highly respected** in the village—calm, honest, caring for TWO disabled people in one household. **Then the roles reversed.** The church—or rather, the **congregants**—now want your land. Your ONLY asset. Your last refuge. **Not to help you. To build housing for the priest.** --- ## Born Into Faith, Not Choice ### The Legacy of Colonization Mary & Lydia didn't "choose" Catholicism. **They were born into it.** When British colonizers arrived in Kenya, they didn't just take land—they **indoctrinated faith**. Villages were assigned churches. Children were baptized. Sunday attendance became social currency. **Mary's family?** Roman Catholic by colonial decree, not personal conviction. But they participated. Mary's mother was **devout**: - Attended every Sunday - Stored church property safely - Fed builders during the decades-long church construction - Raised her daughters in the faith **The church was family.** Until family became a liability. --- ## "The Priest is Busy": When Disability Meets Religious Indifference ### The Accessibility Barrier **Mary and Lydia wanted to attend church.** They tried. But here's what stopped them: - ❌ **Inaccessible dirt road** (full of potholes, ditches, uneven surface) - Mary can't manage with old crutches and specialized shoes - Lydia can't take ANY non-flat route (her disability prevents walking on uneven terrain) - No wheelchair access whatsoever - ❌ **No specialized seating** (they can't sit on wooden benches for 2+ hour services) - ❌ **No congregant assistance** (who has time to help the "lesser beings"?) **The church building?** Literally **30 meters away**. You can hear the choir. You can hear the priest's voice crackling through the cheap speakers. **But those 30 meters might as well be 30 kilometers.** **Mary can't navigate the rutted dirt road with her crutches.** One pothole could mean a fall, a broken bone, months of immobility. **Lydia physically CANNOT walk on non-flat surfaces.** Her body doesn't allow it. She needs smooth, level ground—something the village has never provided. **So they can't attend.** --- ### Multiple Requests, Zero Response **Mary didn't give up.** She tried reaching the priest—**not once, not twice, but MULTIPLE times**: 1. **Request:** Can the priest visit for special prayers? (She can't get to the church.) - **Response:** "The priest is busy." 2. **Request:** Can someone help create an accessible pathway? - **Response:** Silence. 3. **Request:** Can the church provide a special seat for disabled congregants? - **Response:** "Why don't they just attend like everyone else?" **The Irony?** The priest's car drives **RIGHT PAST MARY'S HOUSE** every Sunday. The only road to the church goes through the junction where Mary lives. **He could stop. He never did.** --- ### Even the Sweets Were Sinful **Mary tried to HELP the church:** During her kiosk days, she sold **sweets to children before Sunday service**. The kids would: - Buy candy for 5-10 shillings - Sit quietly in church (sugar-induced calm) - Actually LISTEN to the sermon instead of fidgeting **Parents loved it. Kids loved it.** **Congregants?** They **bad-mouthed her**: > She's corrupting the children. > Making profit from God's day. > The sweets are a distraction from worship. **Translation:** How DARE a disabled woman run a successful business next to OUR church? --- ### The "Blessing Theft" Accusation **Another absurdity:** Villagers would bring **50-shilling notes** to church for tithe/offerings. But the collection dishes only had **small bills**—10 shillings, 20 shillings. **Some congregants asked Mary's kiosk to break their 50-shilling notes into coins** (for easier giving). **Church response?** > You're STEALING the blessings by exchanging money at the kiosk instead of giving the full note to God! **Let that sink in:** - Giving 50 shillings in coins = Stealing blessings ❌ - Giving a 50-shilling note = Blessed ✅ **Even HELPING people give to the church was seen as exploitation.** --- ## The Land They Want: Strategic, Prime, and Stolen Before ### Location, Location, Location **Why does everyone want Mary & Lydia's land?** Because it's at the **most strategic intersection in the village:** **Mary's Land (Junction Quadrant):** 1. 🏘️ **Mary's home** (corner plot) 2. ⛪ **Catholic Church** (directly across the dirt road) 3. 🏫 **Government Primary School** (next quadrant) 4. 🏭 **KTDA Tea Factory** (down the main road) 5. 🚔 **Police Post** (further down) 6. 🛒 **Local Market** (end of the road) **Translation:** This is **village prime real estate**. If local politics and economy had played out right, this location could've made Mary's family **prosperous**. **Instead?** It painted a target on their backs. --- ### The Church Already Took Some of It **When colonial authorities drew village borders**, they didn't care about families. They cut through properties to create roads. **Mary's family lost land TWICE:** 1. **Road construction** (lost a chunk of their property to the dirt road) 2. **Church boundary expansion** (authorities "assigned" part of their land to the church during colonial mapping) **Now the church wants the REST.** **For what?** "Priest housing." **But the church already HAS facilities.** They just want MORE. --- ### The Police, The Chief, and the Greed Chain **It's not just the church.** **2010s: Local authorities wanted the land for a police station.** - They already HAD a police post (still standing, unmaintained) - They wanted a "better location" (Mary's land) - Proposal died due to funding issues (or Mary's resistance) **2020s: The village chief now wants it.** - No clear reason given - Likely personal gain (rent it out? Develop it?) **The pattern?** > Authority sees vulnerable disabled women → Authority wants land → Authority invents justification **Why target Mary & Lydia?** Because they're the **"lesser" beings** in society. No money. No political power. No voice. **Even Mary's mother couldn't speak up**—despite being a RESPECTED church member—because **she had no wealth or influence**. --- ## The Church Used Them, Then Discarded Them ### What Mary's Home Provided (For FREE): **During the decades-long church construction (1990s-2010s):** 1. **Storage Facility** - Church drums 🥁 - Tithe collection dishes 💰 - Musical instruments 🎵 - Kept SAFELY in Mary's home for YEARS 2. **Catering Kitchen** - Fed church builders (concrete mixers, masons, carpenters) - Used Mary's mother's **traditional large cooking pots** - Provided water (fetched from the river by Mary's family) - Provided firewood (gathered by Mary's family) - Provided LABOR (Mary's mother cooked for FREE) 3. **Community Hub** - Villagers gathered at Mary's home to organize church fundraisers - Mary's home = the "church overflow space" for planning meetings **Cost to the church? 0 shillings.** --- ### What the Church Provided Mary & Lydia: 1. **Accessible seating?** ❌ None. 2. **Pastoral care visits?** ❌ "The priest is busy." 3. **Gratitude?** ❌ Bad-mouthed for selling sweets. 4. **Protection from land grabbers?** ❌ The church IS the land grabber. **In Mary's own words (from her video testimony):** > We gave everything to the church. We stored their things. We fed their workers. We attended when we could. But when we needed them? **Ignored.** **When she requested blessings?** > The priest is busy. **When she requested accessible seating?** > Silence. **When she requested protection from land grabbers?** > We need that land for the priest's house. --- ## The Hypocrisy of "Christian" Congregants ### Bible Teachings vs. Real-Life Actions **What the Bible says:** > Defend the weak and the fatherless; uphold the cause of the poor and the oppressed. Psalm 82:3 > Religion that God our Father accepts as pure and faultless is this: to look after orphans and widows in their distress. James 1:27 > Whatever you did for one of the least of these brothers and sisters of mine, you did for me. Matthew 25:40 **What the congregants did:** - ✅ Attended church every Sunday - ✅ Sang hymns loudly - ✅ Gave tithe and offerings - ❌ Refused to help disabled neighbors access the church - ❌ Gossiped about Mary's kiosk "corrupting children" - ❌ Supported land grab efforts against the "lesser beings" **Inside the church?** Holiest people in the village. **Outside the church?** Forgot everything they just heard. --- ### Mary's Mother: The Silent Witness **The Tragic Irony:** Mary's **own mother** is a congregant. She attends every Sunday. She's **respected** in the community. **But she can't speak up for her daughter and granddaughter.** **Why?** - No money = No voice - No political power = No influence - Caregiving for 2 disabled people = Too exhausted to fight **When the church needed her home for storage and cooking?** > Of course! Come in! We're happy to help! **When Mary needed the church to protect her from land grabbers?** > I'm sorry, I don't have the power to stop them. **This is what systemic oppression looks like.** Even the MOTHER of the victim is silenced—not by force, but by **economic and social powerlessness**. --- ## "We Leave It to God for Judgement" ### Why Mary & Lydia Don't Fight Back Publicly **Despite all this betrayal**, Mary and Lydia: - ❌ Don't protest at church meetings - ❌ Don't publicly shame the priest - ❌ Don't file complaints with church authorities **Why?** **Because they "leave it to God for judgement."** **In Kenyan village culture (especially Christian communities):** - **Fighting back = "Disrespecting God's servants"** (even if those servants are corrupt) - **Public confrontation = Social suicide** (you'll be ostracized) - **Trusting God = The "acceptable" response** (even when humans fail you) **Mary's mother taught them this:** > We welcome the church with open hearts and hands. We do what's right. God will judge them. **Translation:** - We'll keep being kind (even when exploited) - We'll keep giving (even when ignored) - We'll trust God to hold them accountable (even when justice never comes) **This is NOT weakness. This is survival strategy in a system rigged against you.** --- ## This Isn't Entitlement. This Is Injustice. ### We're Not Asking for Charity **Mary & Lydia are NOT asking for:** - ❌ Free land from the church - ❌ Financial handouts from congregants - ❌ Special treatment because they're disabled **They're asking for:** - ✅ **Protection of their EXISTING land** (inherited from their mother) - ✅ **Basic accessibility** (a pathway, a seat—so they can attend church like everyone else) - ✅ **Recognition of their contributions** (decades of free storage, free catering, free labor) - ✅ **Equality under God** (if the church preaches love, SHOW IT) **This isn't entitlement. This is asking the church to PRACTICE what it PREACHES.** --- ## Both Sides of the Coin ### What the Church COULD Have Done: **Instead of trying to steal their land, the church could have:** 1. **Built wheelchair-accessible ramps** (cost: ~$200 USD) 2. **Provided specialized seating** (cost: ~$100 USD for 2 chairs) 3. **Assigned a congregant to assist Mary & Lydia** (cost: $0—volunteer effort) 4. **Protected them from land grabbers** (cost: $0—moral duty) 5. **Honored their decades of service** (cost: $0—public acknowledgment) **Total cost to make Mary & Lydia EQUAL members of the church: ~$300 USD.** **Instead, they chose to pursue a land grab worth ~$5,000-$10,000 USD** (prime village real estate). **Greed over grace.** --- ### What the Government COULD Have Done: **Instead of eyeing their land, authorities could have:** 1. **Maintained the EXISTING police post** (instead of demanding new land) 2. **Upgraded the KTDA factory benefits** (so tea farmers like Mary actually profit) 3. **Expanded electricity access BEFORE 2018** (the factory came in 2003, 15-year delay for household power?!) 4. **Created accessible infrastructure** (roads, pathways for disabled residents) **But local politics prioritized:** - ❌ False narratives (e.g., "Electricity will shock you to death!") - ❌ Corruption (tea/coffee profits go to middlemen, not farmers) - ❌ Land grabs (instead of developing what they already own) --- ## The Bigger Picture: Why This Matters ### This Isn't Just About Mary & Lydia **This story exposes:** 1. **Religious Hypocrisy** - Churches preach love but practice exclusion - "Charitable" institutions exploit the vulnerable 2. **Colonial Legacy** - Borders drawn without consent - Faiths imposed without choice - Power structures that still oppress 3. **Disability Discrimination** - "Lesser beings" narrative - Inaccessible public spaces (even churches!) - Denied basic dignity 4. **Property Rights Violations** - Vulnerable populations targeted for land grabs - Authorities abuse power to seize assets - No legal recourse for the poor 5. **Community Exploitation** - Take resources when needed (storage, food, labor) - Discard people when inconvenient - Silence victims through social pressure **If this happens to Mary & Lydia, it's happening to THOUSANDS of disabled people across Kenya.** --- ## The Hard Truth: It's Difficult to Narrow a Lifetime Into 14 Minutes **Mary and Lydia have lived:** - 🕰️ **40+ years of church involvement** - 🏚️ **Decades of providing free services to the church** - 🙏 **Countless requests for basic accessibility—all denied** - 🏡 **Multiple land grab attempts by church, police, and chief** **This blog post?** Just a **snapshot**. **There are HUNDREDS of smaller indignities:** - Being told "You smell" when they can't access bathing facilities - Being excluded from church events because there's no accessible transport - Watching younger, able-bodied villagers get church loans (while they get nothing) - Hearing sermons about "loving thy neighbor" while neighbors plot to evict them **We can't capture a lifetime of storms in one post.** **But we can show you THIS:** Mary & Lydia are NOT asking for miracles. They're asking for **justice**. --- ## What You Can Do ### 1. Donate to Protect Their Land **Immediate need: Legal protection & land title security** - Hire a lawyer to formalize land ownership (prevent future grabs) - Install boundary markers (physical proof of property lines) - Register the land with Kenyan authorities (legal protection) **Cost:** ~$500-$1,000 USD **Donate:** [/donate](/donate) --- ### 2. Share This Story **Why this matters:** - Churches worldwide need to see this hypocrisy - Disability rights activists need to know this is happening - Kenyan communities need to hold institutions accountable **Share on:** - X (Twitter): Tag @CatholicKE, @disabilityrights - Facebook: Post in Kenya community groups - Reddit: r/Kenya, r/disability, r/atheism **Use hashtag:** #ChurchLandGrab #DisabilityJustice #MaryAndLydia --- ### 3. Demand Accessibility in YOUR Church **If you attend a church, mosque, temple, or any place of worship:** **Ask:** - ✅ Do we have wheelchair ramps? - ✅ Do we have accessible seating? - ✅ Do we provide transportation for disabled congregants? - ✅ Do we PRACTICE the compassion we preach? **If the answer is NO, demand change.** **Because if your church can build a new wing for the pastor, it can build a ramp for the disabled.** --- ## Final Thought: Faith Without Works is Dead **The Bible says:** > Faith without works is dead. James 2:26 **The Catholic Church in Mary's village has:** - ✅ Faith (they preach every Sunday) - ❌ Works (they ignore the disabled, covet land, exploit the poor) **Which means their faith is DEAD.** **Mary & Lydia still believe in God.** They still welcome the church with open hearts. **But they've learned the hard truth:** **The church is just a building. The congregants are just humans. And humans, when given power, often choose greed over grace.** #### Lydia's Story

**Can't see the video?** [Watch Mary's story on Vimeo](https://vimeo.com/1140751723) --- **They look forward to a better life despite the storms.** **Will you help them weather this one?** --- ## 🎉 UPDATE: October 22, 2025 - VICTORY! The Land Survey That Shamed the Greedy ### **Finally, Justice Arrived** After **YEARS** of land grab attempts, false claims, and exploitation—**the truth was officially established.** **Date:** October 22, 2025 **Event:** Official digital land survey with government authorities **Who Was There:** - ✅ **Professional digital land surveyors** (government-appointed) - ✅ **Local authorities** (witnesses) - ✅ **Mary & Lydia** (the rightful landowners) - ✅ **Primary school headteacher** (representing education sector) - ❌ **Area Chief** (VANISHED out of shame—couldn't face the truth!) - ❌ **Catholic Priest** (ABSENT—too busy? Or too guilty?) **What Happened:** The survey team: 1. **Measured every boundary** (precise GPS coordinates) 2. **Established every demarcation** (physical markers placed) 3. **Documented every entity** (church, school, Mary's land—all officially recorded) 4. **Exposed the fake titles** (church individuals had created fraudulent land documents!) **The Shocking Discovery:** The **primary headteacher** was found to have been **SET UP by greedy church individuals** who created **FAKE TITLES** to justify their land grab. **Translation:** They tried to steal disabled women's land using FORGED DOCUMENTS. --- ### **The Shameful Truth Exposed** **When the surveyors confirmed Mary & Lydia's legal ownership:** - 😳 **Greedy congregants**: Silent. Caught red-handed. - 🏃 **Area Chief**: FLED. Couldn't face the consequences of his complicity. - 🙈 **Church representatives**: ABSENT. The priest who was "too busy" to visit Mary suddenly became even busier. **The surveyors' conclusion:** > The land belongs to Mary and her family. All claims by other parties are invalid. The boundaries are now officially registered. **Mary and Lydia can finally BREATHE.** 🌬️ --- ### **But Here's the Painful Irony** **The greedy wanted this land SO BADLY** that they: - Created fake titles - Manipulated local authorities - Exploited the headteacher - Ignored disabled women's rights **For what?** A **tiny plot of land**—so small it can barely fit a modest house. **Let that sink in:** **They tried to steal from disabled women. Women who can't even access basic facilities. Women who live in poverty.** **Because greed doesn't see disability. Greed only sees opportunity.** --- ### **What Mary & Lydia Actually Have Now** **Good News:** ✅ The land is OFFICIALLY theirs. No more disputes. **Reality Check:** ❌ The land is **extremely small**—just enough for basic housing. **Current Situation:** - 🏚️ **Poor structures** (you've seen the videos—dilapidated, leaking roofs) - 🚽 **No accessible bathrooms/toilets** (unimaginable for disabled people) - 💧 **No running water** (fetching water is physically impossible for them) - ⚡ **Minimal electricity** (finally connected in 2018, but limited) - 🏗️ **No disability-friendly modifications** (no ramps, no grab bars, nothing) **The land is theirs. But it's not LIVABLE yet.** --- ## 💪 The New Fight: From Land Security to Dignified Housing ### **Now That the Land is Safe, We Need to Build** **Mary & Lydia won the legal battle. Now they need a HOME.** **Not a mansion. Not luxury. Just:** - ✅ **Decent, accessible housing** (wheelchair-friendly doors, ramps) - ✅ **Disability-adapted bathroom/toilet** (grab bars, accessible fixtures—see our [wishlist](/shop) for examples) - ✅ **Safe, waterproof roof** (no more leaking during rainy season) - ✅ **Level flooring** (Lydia cannot walk on uneven surfaces) - ✅ **Running water** (piped to the house—no more impossible fetching) - ✅ **Secure walls** (current structures are literally falling apart) **Estimated Cost:** $5,000-$8,000 USD **For that amount, we can transform their tiny plot into a DIGNIFIED HOME.** --- ### **What Your Donation Will Fund** **Phase 1: Accessibility Construction ($3,000-$5,000)** - 🏗️ Rebuild house with disability-friendly design - 🚪 Wheelchair-accessible doorways and ramps - 🚽 Accessible bathroom with grab bars, raised toilet (see [catalogue examples](/shop)) - 🛁 Roll-in shower with non-slip flooring - 🪟 Windows for ventilation and light **Phase 2: Essential Utilities ($1,000-$1,500)** - 💧 Piped water connection (indoor tap) - ⚡ Upgraded electrical wiring (safe, reliable) - 🔒 Security features (locks, lighting) **Phase 3: Livability Improvements ($1,000-$1,500)** - 🛏️ Proper flooring (smooth, level, wheelchair-friendly) - 🏡 Kitchen modifications (accessible counters, storage) - 🪑 Built-in furniture (beds, seating—adapted for disability) **Total Transformation:** ~$5,000-$8,000 USD **Compare that to the YEARS of exploitation, the fake titles, the land grab schemes—and realize:** **The greedy fought tooth and nail to STEAL this land. You can help us BUILD on it instead.** --- ## 🌟 From Survival to Dignity: The Vision ### **Imagine This Future** **Current Reality:** - 🏚️ Crumbling structures - 🚽 No accessible toilets (humiliating, dangerous) - 💧 No water access (impossible for disabled women) - 🌧️ Leaking roofs (cold, wet, miserable) - 😞 Daily struggle just to exist **With Your Help:** - 🏡 Solid, accessible home - 🚽 Dignified bathroom facilities - 💧 Indoor running water (independence!) - ☀️ Dry, secure shelter - 😊 Ability to LIVE, not just survive **That's the difference your donation makes.** --- ## 📊 Transparency: Every Dollar Documented **We're not asking you to trust blindly.** **When you donate for housing construction, you'll receive:** - 📸 **Photo updates** (every stage of construction) - 🧾 **Receipts** (materials purchased, labor costs) - 🎥 **Video walkthroughs** (Mary & Lydia showing the progress) - 📊 **Budget breakdowns** (exactly where money goes) **100% transparency. Zero overhead. Direct impact.** --- ## ❓ FAQs: The Land Victory & Housing Need ### Q: If they won the land, why do they still need money? **A:** Winning legal ownership ≠ Having a livable home. The land is **tiny** and the structures are **falling apart**. They need to BUILD accessible housing on their newly secured land. ### Q: Can't the church help now that they've been exposed? **A:** **Should they?** Yes. **Will they?** History says no. The priest still hasn't visited. The congregants are silent. The greedy fled. **We're not waiting for the church to develop a conscience. We're building without them.** ### Q: Why not sue for damages/compensation? **A:** Legal battles cost money Mary & Lydia don't have. Plus: - Kenyan legal system is slow and expensive - Disabled women have little power in rural courts - Winning land security was already a miracle **We'd rather spend donation money on BUILDING, not lawsuits.** ### Q: What happens if they get the accessible house? **A:** They can FINALLY: - Live with **dignity** (accessible bathroom = no more humiliation) - Live with **safety** (solid structure = no collapse risks) - Live with **independence** (running water = no dangerous fetching) - Live with **hope** (a real HOME, not a survival shelter) And maybe—just maybe—the church will see what ACTUAL compassion looks like. --- ## 🙏 The Bottom Line: Greed Overlooked Disability. You Can Overlook Greed. **The Shameful Truth:** Greedy people saw: - ❌ Disabled women - ❌ Vulnerable family - ❌ No power, no money, no voice **And thought:** *"Easy target."* **They didn't care that Mary can't walk. They didn't care that Lydia needs accessible facilities. They didn't care about DECADES of free service to the church.** **Greed saw opportunity. Greed attacked.** --- **But You See Differently.** You see: - ✅ Women who deserve dignity - ✅ Survivors who've endured decades of exploitation - ✅ Humans who need a REAL home, not a survival shelter **You can be the opposite of greed. You can be COMPASSION.** --- ## 🚀 Donate Now: Build Mary & Lydia's Accessible Home **The land is theirs. Let's build on it.** **[Donate Now](https://able-hearts.org/donate)** **Every dollar = One step closer to dignity.** --- *This post is part of the AbleHearts Impact Stories series, documenting the lives of Mary & Lydia—two disabled women in rural Kenya fighting for survival, dignity, and justice.* *UPDATE: October 22, 2025 - Land ownership SECURED. Now building accessible housing.* *100% of donations go directly to Mary & Lydia. Zero overhead. Full transparency.*
